peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 15.7% below its local comparables; 16 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (72.1): 4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 290 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,155,000 ($2,188 psf, 979–1,001 sq ft; 6 resales, Apr 2024–Mar 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,597 psf (range $2,018–2,772); 15.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $403,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Road MRT about 520 m, Holland Village MRT about 1,020 m; closer than 173 of 551 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Nanyang Primary School about 870 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 920 m), more than 34 of 551 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Empress Road Market And Food Centre about 310 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Empress Road Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,380 m; Watten House, 12 new sales, about 1,790 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 2,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 106 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,135 new sales and 334 resales (1,469 purchases); new sales were 77.3% of these purchases. Subsales (21) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 334 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 34 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 334 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 350 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.6%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
